name: Black forest cake
description: Three moist chocolate layers with cherry syrup, whipped cream and dark cherries, topped with dripping ganache.

ingredients.name: pure vanilla extract, for the cake
(15 oz) dark sweet cherries in heavy syrup
cold heavy cream, for the whipped cream
pure vanilla extract, for the whipped cream

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F. Grease three 9-inch cake pans, line the bottoms with parchment, and grease the parchment.
Whisk the [flour](@flour), [cocoa](@cocoa), [sugar](@sugar), [baking soda](@baking-soda), [baking powder](@baking-powder), [salt](@salt) and [espresso powder](@espresso) in a large bowl.

In a stand mixer, beat the [oil](@oil), [eggs](@eggs), [sour cream](@sour-cream), [buttermilk](@buttermilk) and [vanilla](@vanilla) until combined. Add the dry ingredients, then the [hot water or coffee](@hot-water), and beat until fully combined.
Divide between the pans and bake 21 to 25 minutes, until a toothpick in the center comes out clean. Cool 30 minutes in the pans, then turn out onto a rack.
Once completely cool, slice a thin layer off each top to level them.

Drain the [cherries](@cherries), saving ¾ cup of the syrup. Simmer that syrup with the [cherry liquor](@kirsch) over low heat until it's down to ¼ cup. Brush it over all three layers, keeping any extra.
Halve the cherries, keeping a few whole for the top.

Put the [chocolate](@chocolate) and [corn syrup](@corn-syrup) in a bowl. Heat the [cream](@ganache-cream) until it just starts to simmer, without boiling. Pour it over the chocolate, wait 2 to 3 minutes, then stir slowly until smooth. Let it cool 10 minutes.
Whip the [cold cream](@whip-cream), [confectioners' sugar](@powdered-sugar) and [vanilla](@whip-vanilla) on medium-high to soft peaks, about 3 minutes.
Set one layer on a plate. Spread on a heaping cup of whipped cream, scatter half the halved cherries, and drizzle with syrup. Repeat with the second layer, then add the third.
Spread the rest of the whipped cream thinly over the top and sides and smooth with a bench scraper.
Pour the ganache over the top and push it to the edges so it drips down the sides. Add the whole cherries. Chill at least 30 minutes before slicing.
tips: Use canned dark sweet cherries in heavy syrup. Fresh, sour or maraschino cherries won't work the same.
Use natural cocoa, not Dutch-process. The hot liquid blooms it for a richer chocolate flavor.
Espresso powder deepens the chocolate without tasting like coffee. If you skip it, use boiling water instead of coffee.
No buttermilk? Put 1 tsp vinegar or lemon juice in a cup, add whole milk to ½ cup, and let it sit 5 minutes.
Plain yogurt can stand in for sour cream, but the cake is less rich.
Room-temperature ingredients mix into a smoother batter.
Make ahead: layers keep wrapped overnight, syrup and whipped cream keep in the fridge overnight, and ganache keeps 3 days.
Keeps 1 day at room temperature or a week in the fridge. Too soft and moist for a tiered cake.
